lead_independence.headline: National Weather Service explains tornado warning issued after Port St. Lucie twister
lead_independence.lead: The National Weather Service in Melbourne issued a tornado warning after reports of funnel clouds started to come in Sunday evening. At the point in which the warning was issued, the tornado had already dissipated. Because this tornado featured very shallow circulation, it was not picked up well by the radar. Reports of the funnel cloud are what then prompted the warning of the EF-0 tornado that became a waterspout at a point.
